headline: Unknown assailants fire shots at singer Asif Akbar's car in Dhaka
summary: The singer escaped unharmed as he was not inside the vehicle when the attack occurred early today in Moghbazar.
details: Unknown assailants opened fire at the private car of singer Asif Akbar in Dhaka’s Moghbazar area early today.
The incident took place in front of Bishal Centre around 4:00 am, according to Saiful Islam, inspector (operations) of Hatirjheel Police Station.
Asif, who maintains a private office in Moghbazar, had parked his car in front of the centre. He was not inside the vehicle when the shooting occurred and escaped unharmed.
The singer informed the police about the attack around 5:00 am, prompting an immediate visit to the scene by law enforcement.
Investigators were unable to collect CCTV footage immediately because the shops at the market were closed at the time of the report.
Police stated they will collect the footage once the shops open and will take further action based on their findings.

Asif, who maintains a private office in Moghbazar, had parked his car in front of the centre. He was not inside the vehicle when the shooting occurred and escaped unharmed.

The singer informed the police about the attack around 5:00 am, prompting an immediate visit to the scene by law enforcement.

Investigators were unable to collect CCTV footage immediately because the shops at the market were closed at the time of the report.

headline_marked: 3 killed as [[bus plunges into ditch]] on Dhaka-Mawa Expressway
headline: 3 killed as bus plunges into ditch on Dhaka-Mawa Expressway
summary: At least 16 others were injured when a speeding bus lost control and crashed into a water-filled ditch in Munshiganj.
details: Three people were killed and at least 16 others injured after a bus lost control and plunged into a ditch on the Dhaka-Mawa Expressway in the Hasara area of Sreenagar, Munshiganj.
The deceased have been identified as the bus supervisor Rokonuzzaman (57), driver's assistant Chanchal Biswas (23), and a passenger named Salahuddin Ahmed (32).
The accident occurred around 3:15 AM on Friday night in the Dhaka-bound lane. The bus, operated by Dorshana Paribahan, was carrying approximately 50 passengers from Chuadanga to Dhaka.

Witnesses and passengers reported that the bus was traveling at a reckless speed from the start of the journey. The driver allegedly tried to overtake a covered van at high speed, causing the vehicle to break through the railing and crash into a ditch.

Fire Service and Civil Defence units from Sreenagar rescued 11 people from the wreckage, while five others received primary treatment at the scene. The ditch was over five feet deep and filled with water, with the front of the bus submerged.
Four critically injured passengers were shifted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital for advanced treatment. The bodies of the three victims were handed over to the highway police.

The Sreenagar Upazila Nirbahi Officer (UNO) confirmed that reckless speeding was the primary cause of the accident. Assistance is being provided to the victims and their families to secure compensation through BRTA.
